mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and thus drives S&P 500 returns higher.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate remains below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is strong and consumer prices are stable, it creates a favorable environment for corporate profitability, driving S&P 500 returns up.
failure_condition: GDP growth and CPI are stable but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate during a tightening cycle can lead to higher borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in consumer prices may lead to inflation concerns, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 270 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is low and the federal funds rate is rising, it may indicate a tightening labor market and potential monetary policy constraints, affecting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Low unemployment and rising FEDFUNDS but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests stronger economic activity, which can positively influence S&P 500 returns as corporate revenues and profits grow.
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeds 100 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.
